instruction: Find the maximum value in the Period per year column and apply bold formatting to it.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding the maximum period per year value and applying bold formatting. Verified with Python: maximum value is 8 at cell B7. The evaluator checks if B7 has bold font formatting applied.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete verification coverage: instruction has two requirements (find maximum + apply bold), but evaluator only checks bold formatting
Does not verify that cell B7 contains the maximum value in the Period per year column
Does not verify that the maximum was correctly identified (value should be 8)
If agent bolds the wrong cell, evaluator cannot detect this error
Getter and metric logic are correct for what they do (checking bold status), but this addresses only 50% of the task requirements
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add a getter to read the cell value at B7 and verify it equals 8
Add a getter to scan the Period per year column and verify 8 is the actual maximum
Use a compound evaluator that checks both: (1) cell contains maximum value AND (2) cell has bold formatting
Alternatively, simplify the instruction to only require bold formatting of a specific known cell
